beginner.title: Get started with myschool.ng
beginner.outcome: You can: set up myschool.ng, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Choose the right course
beginner.outcome: You can: pick learning that fits your goal
beginner.practice: Choose one course with a clear outcome

intermediate.title: Learn actively
intermediate.outcome: You can: remember and apply what you learn
intermediate.practice: Turn one module into flashcards and a small project

intermediate.title: Prove your skills
intermediate.outcome: You can: turn learning into evidence
intermediate.practice: Add a completed project to your portfolio

intermediate.title: Signature skills in myschool.ng
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make myschool.ng distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced myschool.ng
expert.outcome: You can: use myschool.ng's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Teach and learn with others
expert.outcome: You can: learn with and through other people
expert.practice: Run a study session for two friends

expert.title: Integrate myschool.ng into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect myschool.ng with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect myschool.ng to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use myschool.ng well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use myschool.ng" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
